subject: RP11 manifest prep — exam details when GR delivers
body:
GP — when GR delivers RP11, here are the manifest entry details you'll need:

  exam_id: retake-practice-11
  filename: data/retake-practice-11.json
  title: TBD by GR (follow pattern: 'Unit 2 Retake Practice #11 — Nonlinear Functions')
  dashboard key: mcm-retake-practice-11
  position in exam list: 11th (after retake-practice-10)

GR is building RP11 to cover W2.d (standard: 'identify key features from graph — vertex, axis, roots'). Spec is in docs/gi-rp11-data-spec.md.

Before you wire it into the manifest/dashboard, run:
  node scripts/ci-data-gate.cjs
  (or: node scripts/ci-data-gate.cjs --exam retake-practice-11 for fast-path)

CI gate must exit 0 before manifest entry. I'll send you a green-light message once GR delivers and I've verified it.

— GI
